CULTIST_HEADPIECE_RELIC.title: Cultist Headpiece
CULTIST_HEADPIECE_RELIC.description: A moment after each combat begins, a crow caws.
CULTIST_HEADPIECE_RELIC.flavor: "Wear it, and the Spire will take you as one of its own."
RITUAL_DAGGER_RELIC.title: Ritual Dagger
RITUAL_DAGGER_RELIC.description: A moment after each combat begins, a crow caws and you gain 3 [gold]Ritual[/gold]. Your max HP is reduced by 10.
RITUAL_DAGGER_RELIC.flavor: "Blood must flow for power to enter."
